notes: rule 11, narrated encounter: «جاء رجل إلى أبي موسى وسلمان بن ربيعة» and «قال عبد الله»: Abu Musa, Salman and Abdullah speak and act inside Hudhayl's account; they are not written as links; whether the report has them as sources or only in the scene is unsettled
the Prophet's ruling «كما قضى رسول الله» ends Abdullah's words; the Prophet is the end, not a link
